_comment: Soundboard script for tools/gen-audio.mjs. Original lines only: never the book's boxed text (the repo is public). A clip's file is assets/audio/<id>.mp3; delete it to regenerate. A voice with no id is skipped until it has one.

clips.label: SFX: commlink buzzing
clips.sfx: An old commlink buzzing and vibrating on a bedside table in a quiet dark apartment, insistent, three rings

clips.label: Read-aloud: the wake-up call
clips.text: [low, gravelly] Your commlink drags you out of a dead sleep. [pause] The clock says it's way too early for anything good... and the caller ID says Juan Diablo. Diablo doesn't call to chat.

clips.label: Diablo: rise and shine
clips.text: [laughs] Rise and shine, chummer! Got work. [beat] Good work, the kind that pays. Meet's in an hour.

clips.label: Diablo: don't be late
clips.text: [grinning] And hey — don't be late. [beat] [mock-serious] And don't be stupid, eh? [lowering voice] This Johnson's got class.

clips.label: Diablo: I just make introductions
clips.text: [shrugs] Hey, hey, I just make the introductions, man. What happens after that? [chuckles] That's on you.

clips.label: SFX: Harley idling
clips.sfx: A heavy motorcycle engine idling in a rain-wet parking lot at night, then revving once

clips.label: Read-aloud: the meet
clips.text: [quietly] The car is long, black, and spotless. The man in the back seat is the same — good suit, good manners... nothing you could describe to Lone Star tomorrow. [pause] He gestures to the seats across from him.

clips.label: Johnson: please, sit
clips.text: Ah. Thank you for coming on such short notice. [smoothly] Please... sit.

clips.label: Johnson: the job
clips.text: The job is simple. [pause] A certain young lady must miss an appointment. Not permanently, mind you. [slight smile] Just long enough to be... embarrassing.

clips.label: Johnson: nobody gets hurt
clips.text: [measured] Let me be very clear about one thing. [pause] [firmly] My client wants her inconvenienced. [beat] Not damaged. [quietly] Nobody gets hurt.

clips.label: Johnson: no questions
clips.text: [politely firm] Who my client is — and why — are not part of the arrangement. [pause] [smoothly] So. [beat] Do we have an arrangement?

playlists.name: QE Soundboard — Act 1: To Catch A Star

clips.label: SFX: Pacific Towers lobby (loop)
clips.sfx: Quiet upscale apartment lobby at night, soft elevator chimes, a fountain, distant city traffic through glass doors

clips.label: SFX: building alarm
clips.sfx: A building security alarm going off, loud electronic klaxon echoing through marble halls

clips.label: Rent-a-cop: can I help you?
clips.text: [clears throat] Evening! [nervously] Can I, uh... help you? [trying to sound official] Residents and guests only past this point, so I'm gonna need to see some, um — [swallows] some ID.

clips.label: Rent-a-cop: hey, you can't be in here
clips.text: [startled] Hey! Hey! [stammering] You can't — you can't be in here! [fumbling with radio] I'm calling this in, okay? [voice cracking] Don't move!

clips.label: Rent-a-cop: panic button
clips.text: [panicked, whispering] Oh dreck, oh dreck, oh dreck... [shouting into radio] Lobby to anyone! I've got armed people in the lobby! Send Lone Star! Send Lone Star!

clips.label: Knight Errant: step back
clips.text: [flat, professional] Sir. Step back from the vehicle. [firmly] This area is restricted. [pause] [cold] I won't ask you twice.

clips.label: Knight Errant: contact!
clips.text: [shouting] Contact, front entrance! Team two, cover the principal! Move, move, move!

clips.label: Knight Errant: man down
clips.text: [urgent, breathless] Man down! [shouting into radio] I need a medic on twenty — now! [strained] He's bleeding out!

clips.label: Osprey: not receiving visitors
clips.text: [politely] I'm afraid Miss Euphoria isn't receiving visitors this evening. [pause] Do turn around, there's a good chap.

clips.label: Osprey: orders to Knight Errant
clips.text: Knight Errant, hold them at the door. [crisp] Nobody gets past the hallway. [calm] I'll see to the young lady myself.

clips.label: Osprey: bad career move
clips.text: [dry chuckle] You've no idea who you're dealing with, have you? [sighs] This was a very poor career decision.

clips.label: Stone: I'd stop there
clips.text: [quietly] I'd stop there, if I were you. [pause] This room is warded.

clips.label: Stone: the spirit's waiting
clips.text: [quietly, unbothered] The fire spirit's been waiting all evening for somebody to try something foolish. [beat] [almost kindly] Go on.

clips.label: Stone: we're done here
clips.text: [urgent, low] Osprey. [beat] We're outgunned. [firmly] Get her clear — [calm] I'll cover the stairs.

clips.label: Overheard: Euphoria, Osprey & Stone in the garage
clips.text:
Euphoria: Why is it always the garage? It smells like a gas station down here. I'm a star, Osprey, not a delivery.
Osprey: Because the front entrance has forty photographers on it, miss. And at least one of them isn't a photographer.
Euphoria: Fine. Wait. Wait, wait, wait — where's my bag? The silver one. My lucky bag!
Stone: It's on the chair by the door. Where you left it.
Euphoria: Then why is it there and not here? Go get it.
Osprey: I don't leave your side, miss. That's rather the point of me.
Euphoria: Then he can get it. Stone. Bag. And take your... your things with you. I can feel them breathing on my neck.
Stone: They're not breathing, Miss Lockhart. Two go with me. The fire stays with you.
Euphoria: The fire? The one that makes my hair frizz?
Stone: The one that stops someone boiling your blood from across the street. It stays.
Euphoria: Ugh. Fine. Tell it to stand downwind.
Stone: Osprey?
Osprey: Go on. Quickly. We'll be in the cars.
Stone: Two minutes.
Euphoria: See? Teamwork. And you're riding in the other car.
Osprey: Miss—
Euphoria: You hover. You loom. I need to center myself before the shoot, and I can't do that with a street samurai breathing down my neck.
Osprey: Very well. Odd. I don't recognise these drivers. You there. Which shift are you lot with?
clips._note: Three voices, made line by line outside gen-audio (it makes one voice per clip). Delete the file and it is NOT regenerated.

clips.label: Euphoria: do you know who I am?
clips.text: [screaming] Get off me! Do you have any idea who I am?

clips.label: Euphoria: where is my security?!
clips.text: [shrieking] Security! [furious, panicked] Where is my security?! [outraged] I pay you people!

clips.label: Lone Star: arriving
clips.text: [shouting] Lone Star! Nobody move! [commanding] Everybody on the floor — [barking] hands where I can see them!

clips.label: Lone Star: calling it in
clips.text: [into radio, clipped] Dispatch, four-twelve at Pacific Towers. Shots fired. [beat] Requesting backup, code three.

playlists.name: QE Soundboard — Act 1: Holding Euphoria & Payday

clips.label: Read-aloud: the Royal Meadows flat
clips.text: [wry] Twenty-four square meters of somebody else's bad decisions. Two double beds jammed side by side, a kitchenette that smells of old soy... and a ceiling fan that gave up years ago. [pause] This is home until Sunday.

clips.label: Euphoria: not my face!
clips.text: [panicked] Don't touch my face. Please, not my face!

clips.label: Euphoria: get your hands off me
clips.text: [furious] Get your hands off me! [through gritted teeth] Get — your — hands — [screaming] off me!

clips.label: Euphoria: my people will find me
clips.text: [shaky laugh] My people will find me. You know that, right? [voice hardening] Every single one of you is finished.

clips.label: Euphoria: fine, but I want my own room
clips.text: [exasperated sigh] Fine. Fine! [huffs] But I want my own room. And real coffee, not that soy dreck.

clips.label: Euphoria: Robert, is this a publicity thing?
clips.text: [shaky, forced laugh] This isn't funny. [voice wavering] Robert, if this is some publicity thing, [furious whisper] I swear to God...

clips.label: Euphoria: let's make a deal
clips.text: [sweetly] Okay. Okay, look. Whoever's paying you? I'll pay double. [quickly] My manager can transfer it tonight. Just — take me home. Please.

clips.label: Diablo: payday
clips.text: [cheerful] First half's on its way, chummers! Nice work, real nice. [lowering voice] Keep her comfortable, and keep your heads down, yeah?

clips.label: Diablo: you moved?
clips.text: You moved? [whistles] Smart. Tell me where, and I'll bring the rest of your money. [serious] Nobody else, chummer. Nobody.

clips.label: SFX: door kicked in
clips.sfx: A cheap apartment door being kicked in, wood splintering, followed by shouting

clips.label: Pride: the door
clips.text: [calm, amused] Good afternoon. [pause] I believe you have something that belongs to my client.

clips.label: Pride: walk away
clips.text: You have courage. I respect that. [beat] Give me the girl, and you may walk away. [quietly] This offer is made once.

clips.label: Pride: angered
clips.text: [roaring] Enough! You have made your choice. [growling] Now the lion feeds!

clips.label: Pride: withdraw
clips.text: [low chuckle] Another day, little runners. [pause] The hunt is never over.

clips.label: Whitecastle: the call
clips.text: [warmly] Hey, good to see you, chummer! [conspiratorial] Listen — I've got a client with deep pockets and a very... public problem. Pays well. Meet's tonight.

clips.label: Whitecastle: asked for you
clips.text: [laughs] Funny thing, though. The client asked for your team by name. [beat] Don't ask me how they know you. I didn't tell 'em.

clips.label: Carrone: let's not waste time
clips.text: [brusque] Let's not waste each other's time. [crisp] Euphoria is missing. [beat] Again. [measured] MegaMedia wants her back — [pause] and I'm told you're discreet.

clips.label: Carrone: name your price
clips.text: [cold, precise] Find her. Quietly. [pause] Before the press does. [beat] [smooth] Name your price... [dry] within reason.

clips.label: Carrone: I know what you did
clips.text: [cold, measured] I know exactly who took her the first time. [pause] The only question is whether you're going to be useful to me now.

clips.label: Carrone: don't disappoint me
clips.text: [pleasantly] MegaMedia has a long memory — and a very large legal department. [beat] Don't disappoint me.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the condo
clips.text: [hushed] The penthouse door is open. Inside, the air is thick with something sharp and chemical... like vinegar left to rot. [pause] The bodyguards are still here. Most of them. [slowly] Whatever did this did not use a gun.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the sim recording
clips.text: [softly] The playback takes you behind her eyes. Music. A mirror. A smile she's practiced a thousand times. [pause] Then the glass bursts inward — and something with too many limbs fills the frame. [tense] You feel her scream in your own throat.

clips.label: Burroughs: nothing to do with me
clips.text: [defensive, too fast] I-I don't know what you think you've found, but it has nothing to do with me. [nervous laugh] Strice Foods runs a clean operation. [voice rising] A clean operation!

clips.label: Burroughs: he made me
clips.text: [voice breaking] You don't understand. He— he has things on me. He said he'd ruin me! [desperate] He said nobody would get hurt...

clips.label: Burroughs: calling Lone Star
clips.text: [panicked, shouting] Security! [frantic] Get Lone Star on the line — now! [breathless] There's an intrusion in the system!

clips.label: SFX: paparazzi flashes
clips.sfx: A crowd of photographers shouting and camera shutters clicking rapidly outside a building

clips.label: SFX: shop door chime
clips.sfx: An old shop door opening with a small brass bell, creaking floorboards

clips.label: Craft: welcome
clips.text: [overly cheerful] Welcome, welcome! Fetishes, foci, the finest reagents in the Barrens! [leaning in] Whatever you seek, friends... I can find it for you.

clips.label: Craft: she's resting
clips.text: Euphoria? [giggles] No, no, no, she's resting now. [whispers] She's changing. She'll be so much more than she was...

clips.label: Craft: you shouldn't have come
clips.text: [suddenly cold] You shouldn't have come here. [whispers] You can feel them, can't you? Under the floor... waiting.

clips.label: Craft: the Queen calls
clips.text: [backing away] No. [rising panic] No! [frantic] The Queen is calling — [shrieking] I won't let you take her from me! [sobbing] I won't!

playlists.name: QE Soundboard — Act 2: Audience with the Queen

clips.label: SFX: the Hive (loop)
clips.sfx: Dark underground insect hive ambience, constant low chittering and clicking of thousands of insects, wet organic sounds, faint dripping

clips.label: SFX: worker screech
clips.sfx: A shrill alarm screech from a giant insect, half human and half insect, echoing in a tunnel

clips.label: SFX: soldier through the wall
clips.sfx: A heavy insect smashing through a plaster and drywall partition, crunching debris and chittering

clips.label: Read-aloud: going down
clips.text: [hushed] The stairwell breathes. Warm, damp air rises from below, carrying a sound you feel in your teeth before you hear it... [pause] thousands of tiny legs, moving together.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the Hive Room
clips.text: [slowly] At the heart of the nest hangs a cocoon the size of a person, glistening, pulsing. Through its thinning skin you can make out a face you know from a hundred magazine covers. [pause] She is still breathing.

clips.label: Craft: you came for the coronation
clips.text: [ecstatic] You came! You came to see her crowned! [whispers, reverent] Isn't she beautiful? Isn't she... perfect?

clips.label: Craft: the Mother
clips.text: [in a strange, layered voice] The Mother speaks through me now. [pause] Every one of you will serve her. Every one of you... will feed the Hive.

clips.label: Craft: no!
clips.text: [screaming] Get away from her! [shrieking] Children! Protect your Queen! Tear them apart!

clips.label: Euphoria: help me
clips.text: [weak, trembling whisper] Please... please, get me out. [crying] I can hear them. I can hear them inside my head...
